thread:
maya: Quick sync — final go/no-go for tomorrow's public rollout (09:00 PT). Need: changelog permalink, docs anchors, benchmark callouts for the blog, and lead-routing spec for the signup CTA. Keeping it short, who can drop links? :mega:

devon: Changelog PR merged: https://git.redwood/release/changelog/1869 — highlights: improved batching latency, KV cache bugfix, new quantized variant. I'll paste a 1-liner per item in a sec.

samira: Docs will be updated by EOD. I can provide stable permalinks: /docs/release-1869#notable-changes and /docs/release-1869#migration-notes. Which anchors would marketing prefer to link from the post?

jordan: For inbound leads — we want UTM-tagged CTAs hitting /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=release1869 and webhook to our Pardot/SFDC flow. Who owns the webhook endpoint?

liam-bench: Bench numbers ready: median latency down 18% at 128-token workloads, cost-per-1k-tokens reduced 22% vs baseline. I'll attach a short blurb and CSV to the shared drive after this message. Use the 128-token stat for the hero benchmark, please.

devon: webhook is ops-integ team — endpoint is https://hooks.redwood/sales/lead-ingest. @jordan you can route to the campaign id we used for Q1 webinars. Also note: rollout is staged — will flip feature flag to 10% at 09:00 PT, monitor 30m, then 100% at 10:00 if no regressions.

maya: Perfect. Samira, please give the two permalinks + a short migration blurb (1-2 sentences) we can pull into the announcement. Liam — a 2-sentence plain-English benchmark summary would be great for the hero and a technical appendix blurb for the appendix.

samira: Permalinks: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-1869#notable-changes , https://docs.redwood.ai/release-1869#migration-notes. Migration blurb: "Minor client-side changes required for caching headers — no model schema changes; rolling restart recommended for dedicated clusters."

liam-bench: Hero blurb: "Typical latency reduced by ~18% for short-context requests (128 tokens), lowering inference costs by ~22% on common web workloads." Tech appendix blurb: "See attached CSV for p50/p90 across GPU families; quantized variant shows 2–3x memory reduction with negligible quality delta on our eval set."

devon: Also callout: A hotfix for a rare KV cache edge-case landed in runtime at 07:12 PT — no customer-facing change but fixed an internal error spike. Tagging release notes.

jordan: I'll set CTA to include UTM and point webhook to ops endpoint. Can someone confirm which trial plan ID to assign on signups?

maya: Use plan_id=launch_trial_1869. Jordan, I'll DM you the secret for webhook header.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: release/1869 deployed to canary @ 2026-07-15T09:00:00Z — health checks OK.

maya: Thanks all. Action items: @samira final copy + permalinks (done), @liam CSV + 2-line hero (done), @devon confirm staged flip times (09:00 -> 10:00 PT), @jordan wire webhook + UTM (in progress). If no issues by 09:30 PT we proceed with full public blog post and webinar invite batch. :rocket:
